author: Miles, Wilfrid
title: Military Operations: France and Belgium, 1916, Volume II: 2nd July 1916 to the End of the Battles of the Somme
publisher: Macmillan, London (History of the Great War based on Official Documents)
notes: The Somme from 2 July to 18 November 1916, compiled by Captain Wilfrid Miles rather than by Edmonds, who edited the series. This is the official account of Flers-Courcelette on 15 September 1916, the first action in which tanks were used — which the tech rail presently takes from source:fuller-1920, the Tank Corps' own senior staff officer writing a brief for the weapon, and from source:1914-1918-online-tanks, a survey. An official history is rung 1 and a unit history rung 3; this volume is what should be carrying that count. Nothing cites it yet. Note that the tank numbers for 15 September are disputed between the sources already in the registry, so when this volume is read the count it gives goes beside them rather than over them.
